claims: Samsung is discontinuing its native Samsung Messages app by July 2026.
Samsung is shifting entirely to Google Messages as the default RCS messaging platform on Galaxy devices.
Older phones (Android 11 or earlier) are unaffected.
Newer Galaxy devices (S26 and later) will not support the Samsung Messages app.
Samsung Messages will stop functioning for most users, including receiving/sending texts, by July 2026.
Samsung is partnering with Google for a more consistent RCS (Rich Communication Services) experience.
Tizen OS-based smartwatches (older than Galaxy Watch4) will lose full message conversation history when this change occurs.
Users who prefer Samsung Messages will lose features like custom chat rooms.
Google Messages brings new features like AI-powered spam detection and Gemini-based interactions.
